learning_outcomes.text: Realizing the importance of physics of flow in industrial development.
Realizing the distinguishing properties of fluids and the relationships between them.
Comprehending the treatments of fluids which behaves statically in fact they can be either static or dynamic.
Comprehending the properties which differ fluid mechanics from solid mechanics.
Adapting the physical conservation laws to the fluid motion.
Knowing the effects of fluids which can be in either static or dynamic behaviour on the surfaces which are encircled by the fluid.
